name: Franklin Ace Pro Ball Machine
description: The Franklin Ace Pro is a battery-powered pickleball ball machine that holds 120 balls and feeds dinks, drives, and lobs with adjustable spin. A wireless remote and 12 preset drills let a single player practice the third-shot drop without a partner. The rechargeable lithium battery lasts about four hours per charge.
care_instructions: Store indoors and fully charge the battery every 30 days when not in use. Clear debris from the feed wheel after each session and never run the machine in rain.
